brief: Two-storey cream-brick commercial building of 1847 with a low metal-covered gable roof behind a stepped end parapet and chimney, a plain front of 6/6 upper windows and a ground floor with two tall shop openings under a lettered sign band, an exterior wooden stair on the side; brick-paved street and a 1930s car at the curb in the HABS view. HABS drawings record it.

facade.notes: the Meinhardt Bank (Burlington WI, 1847): a two-storey brick building with stepped gable ends and a metal roof, 'MEINHARDT BANK' painted across the brick, an outside wooden stair up the side; a brick street; a 1920s car; a traffic light on a lamp post

why.note: the two-part block: business below, offices or rooms above
the name painted on the brick: the 1850s-1920s sign
